name: Yama's Paasam
description: A supernatural rope/noose used by Yama to punish people in Yamadonga (2007). Raja steals it; the film's plot review states that whoever possesses it becomes Yama.
origin: Yama's Paasam in the Yamaloka setting of Yamadonga (2007).
strengths: Used by Yama as the rope with which he punishes people.
weaknesses: It can be stolen; when Raja takes it, Yama loses the authority associated with it.
specialAbilities: Possession of the Paasam transfers the position/power of Yama to its holder, as described in the film plot review.
